products.name: Gauth Unlimited Digital Canvas
products.tagline: An AI tutor on an infinite whiteboard, not a chat thread
products.description: Gauth AI Course now runs on an Unlimited Digital Canvas: one continuous whiteboard where lessons unfold spatially instead of in a chat thread or slide deck. Chapters expand side by side as narration plays, board notes write out in sync with the AI voice, and you can zoom from the full concept map down to a single formula. Pause anytime to ask the AI Tutor, and it answers right on the board beneath your step. Generate a canvas lesson on any topic, then export it as a PDF or share a link.

products.name: Veltrix AI for E-commerce
products.tagline: Find how your e-commerce business could earn more
products.description: Find ways to make your e-commerce business more profitable. Veltrix uses AI to analyze your sales, costs, customers and marketing. Get help deciding what to promote, where to cut spending and how to solve problems holding the business back. Connect your business tools or upload files. Start with a Business Health Check to find improvements you may have missed. Then use Veltrix to work out what to improve. Your first check is free. No card required.

products.name: Teachoo
products.tagline: AI that helps you learn anything and everything.
products.description: Teachoo helps students work through homework one question at a time. Type a problem or upload a photo, then work toward the answer with guided questions, feedback and hints. Need more help? Ask for a bigger hint or an explanation of the step. Free to use. Try a problem you haven’t solved in years.

products.name: Famulor
products.tagline: Your agent to answer calls and follow ups on WhatsApp
products.description: Famulor answers calls, runs campaigns and follows up on WhatsApp. GDPR-ready, EU hosting. Try it free.

products.name: Eleven v4 and Eleven v4 Turbo
products.tagline: Elevenlabs' fastest and most emotive voice models yet
products.description: Meet Eleven v4 and Eleven v4 Turbo by ElevenLabs, their most expressive models yet, with Turbo built for real-time use. Available in apps, API, and agents.

products.name: Mintlify Desktop
products.tagline: An AI-native app for writing documentation and knowledge
products.description: A dedicated home for all your documentation, from internal knowledge bases, runbooks and onboarding guides to public docs. Keep projects open side by side across organizations and pick up where you left off. An agent works alongside you on the page you’re editing, while local files let you write offline and sync when you reconnect. Tabs, split views, and persistent sessions help you move between projects without losing context.

products.name: ShipHQ
products.tagline: Build your own app studio, powered by your real apps
products.description: ShipHQ turns your app's real numbers into a living isometric startup office. Connect RevenueCat and every paying subscriber becomes a person at your desks. Each morning the Daily Brief replays last night: new subscribers walk in to applause, trials arrive in caps, churn gets a send-off. Milestones land as trophies on your wall — earned, never bought, never retroactive. AI managers bring a 09:00 standup on growth, reviews and competitors. Free on iPhone.

products.name: Bambu Lab R1
products.tagline: CO2 laser cutting with Bambu-style automation
products.description: Bambu Lab R1 is a 55W CO2 laser cutter built around automation. It handles optical alignment, material positioning and surface tracking for you, with a 600 × 300 mm work area, clear acrylic support, and optional conveyor processing up to 3 meters.

products.name: Clef
products.description: Clef is a 27B multimodal model that turns a state and a schema of typed questions into decisions. It reads the state as text, JSON, images, or video, and returns a probability for every allowed option of every question in a single forward pass. There is no free-form text generation and no output parsing. The Clef API is fully compatible with Jev and SystemOne.

products.name: Open Inspector
products.tagline: Hover any website, get its design system. Open-source. Free.
products.description: A free, open-source browser extension for inspecting layout, styles, colour, type and assets on any page, and exporting its design tokens. Unlike the popular alternatives, it requests no site access and makes zero network requests. MIT, no account.

products.name: Cue by Manus
products.tagline: Personal agents with identity, handling life end to end
products.description: Whatever life brings, your personal agents on Cue handle it — each with its own email, phone number, wallet and computer to get real work done.

products.name: Syllaby AI Avatar 2.0
products.tagline: Create Your Own Avatar In Seconds
products.description: Turn a script or simple idea into a complete presenter-led video with a realistic AI avatar, natural voice, B-roll and subtitles—without hiring actors,

products.name: Wu
products.tagline: Fast, native code editor in Rust that feels like VS Code
products.description: Wu is a code editor for people who want the speed of a native app and the familiarity of VS Code.

products.name: Lloyal
products.tagline: Turn open-weight models into AI apps people can download
products.description: Start with a working TypeScript AI app with built-in inference and a multi-agent runtime. In-app agents can research, read local files, understand documents and compose specialist models. Works offline, no API keys or complicated setup for your users. Customize and ship it to desktop, web or terminal in minutes 🚀

products.name: Anthroposcaper
products.tagline: Tag a 2D plan, get a 3D urban environment model
products.description: Draw a 2D plan in the browser or import a DXF, then tag its faces and lines. Turn your own GLB models into templates, and Anthroposcaper lays them along every matching edge, corners and junctions included, into a textured 3D scene. Change one tag or drawing and the scene rebuilds. Export to GLB for your 3D editor or game engine. Connect your AI agent over MCP: it helps set up templates, configure tags and materials, and keep the project organized. You stay in control of the result.
